name: Dream Kitchen — Three Picks
description: Quiz-picker 3-step kitchen configurator: tap a style swatch → instant recolor. Step 1 = style (Modern/Farmhouse), Step 2 = countertop (Quartz/Marble), Step 3 = backsplash tile (Herringbone/Subway). All 8 combos visible; reveal adds bonus-delta (pendant lights, golden-hour glow); endcard shows the exact kitchen the user built.
